tool_signatures.name: inspection
tool_signatures.description: Inspect code for ABC complexity, UsedOnce, and NeverUsed findings. AbcSize reports a function only when its score rose against HEAD; a score that stayed the same or fell stays quiet, even when the function is still over the ceiling. ModuleAbcSize does the same for a whole module: an existing module may stay over the ceiling when its score did not rise, and a new module is held to the ceiling. Clear either finding by bringing the score back to the HEAD score when that score was already over the ceiling, otherwise back to the ceiling. UsedOnce and NeverUsed report only inside functions whose text changed against HEAD. Pass `path` (string or array), `paths`, and/or `source_code` (inline; `path` picks language). Always pass an explicit project path.
